brand_identity.name: Punche Creativo
brand_identity.positioning: Casa creativa enfocada en credibilidad, creatividad y eficacia de alto impacto. Activaciones, audiovisual, merchandising, branding y logística integral.
brand_identity.aesthetic: Pop-art meets Swiss Neo-Brutalism & Editorial Craft. Bold Roy Lichtenstein Ben-Day halftone textures, thick 2px-3px ink strokes, crisp sticker badges, starburst punch accents, paired with generous whitespace, high-legibility typography, and kinetic line-by-line masked reveals.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup CSS Theme Tokens: In /app/frontend/src/index.css, import '@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk', '@fontsource-variable/dm-sans', and '@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono'. Configure font families and pop-art / neo-brutalist custom utilities (halftone dot background pattern, hard offset box-shadows, starburst punch accents).
2. Maintain strict TypeScript types across all components. Avoid 'any'.
3. Implement Lenis smooth scrolling or smooth kinetic feel using framer-motion (motion/react).
4. Ensure the official Logo (webp asset provided) is featured in the Header, the Hero 3D punch reveal card, and the Footer.

5. Build the Backend Contact Inquiry API in FastAPI: POST /api/contact, GET /api/contact/inquiries (for admin review/confirmation), saving submissions with timestamp, id, status, and lead source to MongoDB with proper Pydantic schemas and indexed fields.
6. Build an interactive Contact section with instant feedback via Sonner toast notifications and interactive quote calculator / service selector.

7. Implement all 5 service pillars exactly as requested by the advertiser: 1. Eventos (Activaciones, Corporativos, Aniversarios, Lanzamientos, Gymkanas, Campeonatos), 2. Audiovisual (Videos Institucionales, Publicitarios, Drone, Fotografía), 3. Merchandising (Nacional, Importados, Fabricación), 4. Diseño e Impresión (Logo, Branding, Revistas, Agendas, Manual de marca), 5. Logística (Mobiliario, Luces, Sonido, Estrados).
8. Populate the Clients & Brands section with high-profile Peruvian and multinational brand categories and compelling testimonial cards.
9. Add data-testid to every single button, nav link, tab, filter, and input element for automated testing reliability.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Generous Spacing: Use py-20 to py-32 for section containers. Add internal padding to bordered cards to prevent collision.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.interactivity: Every interactive card should have hover micro-interactions: slight lift (-translate-y-1), shadow expansion (shadow-[6px_6px_0px_#121212]), and button click bounce.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner for all user notifications (contact form sent, quotation initiated).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.typography: Use Space Grotesk Variable with font-black / tracking-tight for headers, IBM Plex Mono for badges/numbers/metadata, and DM Sans for readable body copy.
